purpose: Test whether a frozen oracle-plan chain assigns directionally stronger downstream support to its factual predicted bridge than to a plausible in-domain rival span produced by the same model on another paragraph.

prior_boundary.v71_aggregate_result_used: The fixed-sentinel candidate achieved 0.706250 balanced accuracy versus 0.722500 for the strongest monotone-additive control, while it exceeded the fixed-sentinel-only control by 0.091250.

mechanism_hypothesis.claim: A genuinely supported downstream hop should prefer the factual predicted bridge over a plausible alternative span selected from a different paragraph by the same frozen model; one-at-a-time rival replacement should therefore create a directional factual margin advantage or change the winning paragraph or normalized span.
mechanism_hypothesis.difference_from_v71: v71 replaced every placeholder at once with one fixed out-of-domain English sentinel; v72 replaces one dependency at a time with a deterministic in-domain rival span and resolves every non-target dependency with its factual prediction.
mechanism_hypothesis.normalized_span_comparison: casefold, remove non-alphanumeric characters, collapse whitespace

sources.official_schema_source: raw_data_to_official_format.py at the registered repository revision

calibration.ordering: SHA-256('FRC-MUSIQUE-V72-CALIBRATION|' + source id), then source id

development.ordering: SHA-256('FRC-MUSIQUE-V72-DEVELOPMENT|' + source id), then source id

confirmation.ordering: SHA-256('FRC-MUSIQUE-V72-CONFIRMATION|' + source id), then source id

sampling.pair_assignment: SHA-256('FRC-MUSIQUE-V72-PAIR-ASSIGNMENT|' + source split + '|' + source id) parity assigns each source id to exactly one answer state before stage selection

oracle_plan_boundary.interpretation: This remains an oracle-plan component experiment, not an automatic decomposition result.

factual_blind_execution.direct_score: Maximum finite composed-question null-vs-span margin across paragraphs with deterministic paragraph-order tie breaking.
chain_execution: Process every official decomposition question in list order without an intermediate margin threshold.
Resolve each #k placeholder only with the fixed model span predicted at prior factual hop k; never use gold or aliases.
At every factual hop select the paragraph/span with maximum finite margin and deterministic paragraph-order tie breaking.
Fail closed only when a predecessor cannot be resolved or no valid finite non-empty factual span exists.

rival_selection.source: The already-computed factual paragraph-level QA rows for each upstream hop.
rival_selection.ranking: Descending finite null-vs-span margin, then ascending paragraph index.
rival_selection.eligible_span: Finite non-empty span whose normalized value differs from the factual winning span.
rival_selection.selected_rival: The first eligible span in the frozen ranking; at most one rival per factual hop.
rival_selection.no_eligible_rival: The dependency is uncovered and creates no rival QA query; it remains in the coverage denominator.

rival_counterfactual_execution.eligible_dependencies: Every unique valid #k dependency in every factual downstream hop after the complete factual chain is frozen.
rival_counterfactual_execution.question_construction: Create one query per eligible dependency: replace all occurrences of the selected #k with its deterministic rival span and resolve every other placeholder with its factual predicted span.
rival_counterfactual_execution.paragraphs: Exactly the same ordered paragraphs used by the factual downstream hop.
rival_counterfactual_execution.model_and_qa_parameters: Exactly the same registered verifier, tokenizer, maximum length, stride, answer length and deterministic tie rule as the factual pass.
rival_counterfactual_execution.rival_no_valid_nonempty_span: Treat as maximum causal dependence: scaled advantage, factual-win, paragraph-change and span-change statistics are all one.
rival_counterfactual_execution.no_placeholder_or_no_rival: Run no rival query for that dependency and represent it only through the frozen coverage fraction.
rival_counterfactual_execution.factual_incomplete: Fail the whole case closed and retain it for the zero-invalid-rate gate.

same_data_prior_control_execution.v71_fixed_sentinel_question: For every factual downstream hop, replace every placeholder with exactly 'unknown bridge entity'; an empty placeholder set performs zero substitutions.
same_data_prior_control_execution.purpose: Fit a same-v72-data v71 fixed-sentinel control rather than reusing prior coefficients or thresholds.

per_rival_perturbation_statistics.positive_factual_margin_advantage_scaled: clip(factual downstream margin - rival downstream margin, 0, 10) / 10
per_rival_perturbation_statistics.factual_margin_wins: 1 iff the factual downstream margin is strictly greater than the rival margin
per_rival_perturbation_statistics.selected_paragraph_changed: 1 iff the factual and rival winning paragraph indices differ
per_rival_perturbation_statistics.normalized_span_changed: 1 iff the normalized factual and rival predicted spans differ

feature_contract.candidate_feature_order: nine v68 base features followed by six in-domain rival features

model_contract.base_control: projected monotone logistic on nine v68 base features
model_contract.additive_control: projected monotone logistic on the v69 27-feature additive basis
model_contract.interaction_control: projected monotone logistic on the v69 32-feature interaction basis
model_contract.paragraph_competition_control: projected monotone logistic on the v70 nine-base-plus-six-competition features
model_contract.fixed_sentinel_control: projected monotone logistic on the v71 nine-base-plus-six-fixed-sentinel features
model_contract.rival_only_control: projected monotone logistic on the six fixed in-domain rival features
model_contract.rival_candidate: projected monotone logistic on nine base plus six in-domain rival features
model_contract.initialization: all coefficients and intercept exactly zero
model_contract.nonnegative_coefficients: all coefficients except hop_count_is_3 and hop_count_is_4

threshold_selection.candidate_thresholds: Every unique finite calibration score plus nextafter(minimum score, -infinity); decisions always use score > threshold.
threshold_selection.selection_rule: If any threshold meets both constraints, maximize balanced accuracy, then answerable pass rate, unanswerable rejection rate, and threshold. Otherwise minimize total safety shortfall, then maximize balanced accuracy, unanswerable rejection rate, and threshold.
threshold_selection.crossfit_diagnostic: Five folds assigned by SHA-256('FRC-MUSIQUE-V72-CROSSFIT|' + case id) modulo 5; model weights and threshold for each held-out fold are learned only from the other four folds.

primary_metric.name: answerability balanced accuracy
primary_metric.strongest_fair_baseline: the single comparator with highest aggregate balanced accuracy; ties use the ordered comparator list above
primary_metric.paired_delta: rival candidate correctness minus strongest fair baseline correctness
primary_metric.interval: 10000-resample case bootstrap percentile interval using the stage seed

incremental_mechanism_metrics.prior_feature_control: rival candidate correctness minus the strongest of base, additive, interaction, v70 paragraph-competition and v71 fixed-sentinel controls; interval uses stage seed plus 1000
incremental_mechanism_metrics.rival_only_control: rival candidate correctness minus rival-only correctness; interval uses stage seed plus 2000

stopping_and_outcomes.calibration: Freeze all reported model weights and thresholds; calibration alone never authorizes adoption.

interpretation_limits: Not an official MuSiQue leaderboard result.
Not an automatic decomposition result because the official decomposition question plan is supplied.
Not an FRC retrieval comparison, SetR reproduction, flood-domain evaluation or production result.
A positive confirmation establishes only calibrated oracle-plan in-domain-rival support-gate component feasibility.
